google-cloud-description: We are proud to announce that Profil Indah Management System, along with its robust infrastructure, is powered by Google Cloud Platform. Leveraging the same cutting-edge technology that supports international enterprises, our partnership with Google Cloud ensures unparalleled performance, security, and scalability. Join us in celebrating this world-class collaboration, driving innovation and excellence.

login__subtitle: Sign in with your office account
login__forgot: Forgot your password? Contact an administrator

settings__lede: Appearance choices take effect at once and are stored in this browser.
settings__mode_note: Light for lit rooms, dark for tired eyes.
settings__accent_note: Sets the colour of buttons, the active menu, and selection marks throughout the app.
settings__language_note: Changes the interface wording, not the data itself.
product__lede: Product catalogue with brands and types.
product__create__lede: Add a new product to the catalogue.
product__create__units-hint: The first unit is the smallest one (base unit). Each following unit is converted against the one above it.
product__create__add-unit: Add a unit — e.g. "BOX", then fill in its ratio to the unit above
product__brand__add__lede: A new brand can be used in the product form right away.
product__type__add__lede: A new type can be used in the product form right away.
product__brand__update__lede: Renaming applies at once to every product using it.
product__type__update__lede: Renaming applies at once to every product using it.
good-receipt__lede: Goods received from supplier delivery notes.
good-receipt__create__price-saved: Purchase price saved to the product master.
good-receipt__create__lede: A goods receipt and a purchase invoice are one record — administrators see the prices.
good-receipt__create__no-item: No products yet. Add them from the product list.
good-receipt__create__no-price-hint: A goods receipt only records incoming quantities. Prices are entered separately through the Purchase Invoice.
good-receipt__create__save-price__on: This purchase price will be saved to the product master
good-receipt__create__save-price__off: This purchase price applies to this receipt only
good-receipt__create__check-quantity: Quantity filled in for every product
product-selector__lede: Tap a product to add one line. The same product may be added repeatedly.
good-receipt__state__do__note: The document stays Awaiting invoice until completed.
good-receipt__state__full__note: The document is final and enters supplier payables.
good-receipt__invoice__discount__note: In Rupiah, on top of each line discount.
good-receipt__invoice__waiting: Supplier invoice no., tax invoice no. and document discount are filled in later — open it from the list of receipts marked "Awaiting invoice".
good-receipt__create__duplicate: The same product appears on several lines — intentional? A supplier bonus, for example.
good-receipt__state__do__desk: Goods have arrived, the supplier invoice has not.
good-receipt__state__full__desk: The supplier invoice is in hand — fill it in now.
sales-invoice__lede: Invoices with their customer, salesperson, and payment state.
sales-invoice__search: Search invoice number, customer, or salesperson…
stock-list__lede: Remaining stock per item, with its card and mutations.
overpayment__lede: Customer money waiting to be returned
overpayment__create__lede: Customer money exceeding the bill — recorded, then scheduled for return
overpayment__create__receiver-hint: The person collecting the money at the counter
empty__search__desc: Try another keyword, or check the spelling.
product__empty__desc: The catalogue is empty. Add one with the Add item button above.
product-brand__empty__desc: Brands group the catalogue. Add one with the button above.
product-type__empty__desc: Types group the catalogue. Add one with the button above.
stock-list__empty__desc: Stock appears once items are received or adjusted.
sales-invoice__empty__desc: Invoices issued this month will appear here.
good-receipt__empty__desc: Goods received this month will appear here.
overpayment__empty__desc: Customer money exceeding the bill will be recorded here.
company__lede: Companies that issue and receive documents.
company__empty__desc: Companies are used on invoices and receipts. Add one with the button above.
expense__lede: Expenses recorded in the selected month.
expense__empty__desc: Pick another month with the chip above, or record a new expense.
sales-invoice__create__lede: Prices and discounts are recalculated when the invoice is issued.
sales-invoice__create__price-note: The prices and discounts shown will be recalculated when the invoice is issued.
sales-invoice__create__no-item: No items yet. Add one with the button above.
sales-invoice__create__duplicate: The same item appears on several rows — intended? A bonus or a different price, perhaps.
settings__avatar_note: The picture shown in the top bar and on records you create.
sales-invoice__rebate__note: If the discount is handed back to the customer as money (cash or transfer), record it here so the daily report matches the bank.
sales-invoice__rebate__on-invoice__note: The price is reduced; no money leaves.
tax-invoice__hint: No hyphens or dots · max. 16 digits
set-avatar__lede: Pick the shape directly — no need to try one by one
set-avatar__live: Changes show in the preview straight away
promotion__lede: Supplier programmes with their target and achievement.
promotion__empty__desc: Supplier programmes will appear here. Create one with the button above.
promotion__create__lede: Supplier programme: a spend target on chosen brands within a period.
promotion__create__brands-empty: No brands yet. Search and pick from the field above.
promotion__create__rules-empty: No SKU rules — without rules, every SKU of the chosen brands counts.
promotion__create__optional-note: End date and target may be left empty when not applicable — the promotion is treated as ongoing and without a specific target.
customer__add__lede: A new customer can be picked on invoices right away.
sales-invoice__type__sales__desk: The buyer comes, goods go out right away.
sales-invoice__type__sales__note: Paid on the spot, or recorded as receivable.
sales-invoice__type__deposit__desk: Money held for goods that have not arrived.
sales-invoice__type__deposit__note: The money is recorded; the goods follow.
sales-invoice__type__internal__desk: Goods set aside so they are not sold.
sales-invoice__type__internal__note: Stock is held — no money comes in.
company__create__lede: Companies are used on invoices and receipts.
company__update__lede: Edit its details, or delete it when no longer used.
customer__lede: Customers with their address and person in charge.
customer__empty__desc: Customers are used on invoices and deposits. Add one with the button above.
customer__update__lede: Edit their details, or delete when no longer used.
general__allready-deleted: This record has already been deleted.
overpayment__create__bank-error: Bank and account number are required for transfer returns.
supplier__lede: Suppliers with their address and tax ID.
supplier__empty__desc: Suppliers are used on good receipts and promotions. Add one with the button above.
supplier__add__lede: A new supplier can be picked on good receipts right away.
supplier__update__lede: Edit their details, or delete when no longer used.
payment-method__lede: Payment options available on invoices and deposits.
payment-method__empty__desc: Payment methods are used on invoices and deposits. Add one with the button above.
payment-method__add__lede: A new method can be picked on invoices right away.
payment-method__update__lede: Edit their details, or delete when no longer used.
adjustment-case__lede: Stock corrections for found or lost goods, applied after admin confirmation.
adjustment-case__empty__desc: Submitted stock adjustments are recorded here. Create one with the button above.
adjustment-case__create__lede: Record found or lost goods. Stock changes after admin confirmation.
adjustment-case__type__found__desk: Extra goods found in the warehouse. Stock increases.
adjustment-case__type__found__note: A company owning the goods must be selected.
adjustment-case__type__lost__desk: Goods lost or damaged. Stock decreases.
adjustment-case__type__lost__note: No company — recorded as a store loss.
adjustment-case__create__no-item: No items yet. Add them from the product list.
adjustment-case__create__duplicate: The same product appears more than once in this list.
adjustment-case__create__confirm-note: Stock only changes after admin confirmation. Submitted cases wait on the Confirmation page.
adjustment-case__confirm__lede: Cases waiting for an admin decision. Once approved or rejected, they move to the archive.
adjustment-case__confirm__empty__desc: All adjustments have been decided. New cases appear here as soon as they are submitted.
adjustment-case__approve__lede: Review the contents once more before stock changes.
adjustment-case__approve__note: Once approved, the adjustment is applied to stock immediately and enters the accounting journal. This action cannot be undone.
general__network-error: Cannot reach the server. Check whether the backend is running.
sales-price__lede: Sales price and discount per unit for every product.
sales-price__empty__desc: Products appear here once created from the product page.
sales-price__update__lede: One row per unit. Discounts are in Rupiah and apply to the next invoice.
purchase-price__lede: Purchase price and discount per unit for every product.
purchase-price__empty__desc: Products appear here once created from the product page.
purchase-price__update__lede: One row per unit. Discounts are in Rupiah and apply on good receipts.
price__discount-too-high: The discount exceeds the price itself.
expense__add__lede: The expense goes straight into the current month list.
expense__update__lede: Edit the details, or delete if recorded by mistake.
expense-type__lede: Fixed parent categories, free sub-types — expenses are recorded on sub-types.
expense-type__baku-note: Parent categories are fixed by the system and cannot be changed — that is what keeps reports uniform. Sub-types beneath them can be added freely with the button above.
expense-type__empty__desc: Run the expense type seeder on the server to fill the fixed categories.
expense-type__no-children: No sub-types in this category yet.
expense-type__create__lede: A new sub-type can be picked right away when recording expenses.
expense-type__update__lede: Edit the details, or delete when no longer used.
expenseType.parentInvalid: The parent category is unknown or not a fixed category.
expenseType.fixed: Fixed categories cannot be changed or deleted.
package__lede: Bundle several products under one package price — shown as a single invoice line.
package__empty__desc: Packages can be picked on sales invoices as a single line. Create one with the button above.
package__create__lede: Package contents are priced proportionally on invoices; the total always equals the package price.
package__create__no-item: No items yet. Add them from the product list.
package__create__check-info: Name, description, and package price filled in
package__update__lede: The name, description, and package price can change; the contents cannot.
package__update__content-note: Package contents cannot change once created — old invoices are computed from this composition. If the contents change, create a new package and delete this one.
package-selector__lede: Pressing a row adds the package to the document — one package, one line.
user__lede: Accounts that can sign in to the system, with their roles.
user__empty__desc: New users get a system-generated password shown once. Add one with the button above.
user__create__lede: The password is generated by the system and shown ONCE after saving.
user__create__types-note: Warehouse role only: pick the product types they are allowed to sell.
user__edit__lede: Edit the details, or delete when they no longer work here.
user__status__lede: Write the password down NOW — for security it will never be shown again.
user__status__copied: User details copied to the clipboard.
supplier-report__lede: What is bought from this supplier, how often, and for how much.
supplier-report__empty: No purchases in this range yet.
product__update__lede: Edit the product identity. Prices are changed on the Price pages.
product__update__price-note: Prices are not edited here — use the Sales Price or Purchase Price menu.
sales-return__archive__lede: Every sales return document, by month.
sales-return__empty__desc: Returns created from sales invoices will appear here.
sales-return__create__payment-method-hin: Leave empty if no money is refunded to the customer.
sales-return__create__no-item: No items yet. Add them with the button above or Alt + A.
sales-return__create__no-invoice: No invoice matches the date and items above.
sales-return__create__check-mapping: Every item mapped to an invoice line
deposit__list__lede: Deposits are created from the sales invoice form; review and confirm them here.
deposit__list__empty__desc: New deposits are created from the sales invoice form with the deposit type.
deposit__archive__empty__desc: Deposit documents from the selected month will appear here.
deposit__confirm__lede: The deposit becomes an invoice. Its items and charges carry over; only the invoice date and settlement are decided here.
deposit__confirm__items-note: Items cannot be changed during confirmation — the whole deposit goes into the invoice.
deposit__confirm__check-payment: Payment does not exceed the bill
archives__lede: Pick a month to open its documents.
receivable__lede: Each customer's outstanding balance from unpaid invoices.
receivable__empty__desc: Every customer invoice has been paid.
receivable__view__empty__desc: All of this customer's invoices are settled.
receivable__payment__lede: The amount is capped at this invoice's remaining balance.
receivable__payment__none: No payments on this invoice yet.
purchase-invoice__queue__lede: Receipts whose goods are recorded, waiting for the supplier's invoice to arrive.
purchase-invoice__queue__empty__desc: Every goods receipt has its invoice completed.
purchase-invoice__archive__search: Search invoice number, document, or supplier…
purchase-invoice__empty__desc: Purchase documents from the selected month will appear here.
purchase-invoice__complete__lede: Items and quantities belong to the receipt and already moved stock; what is completed here is the supplier invoice and its prices.
purchase-invoice__complete__items-note: Quantities cannot be changed here — they were recorded at receiving. The bookmark saves the price to the product master.
report__landing__lede: Pick a report to open. Only those your role may see are shown.
report__landing__sales__desc: Monthly sales value: daily chart, by brand, type, and salesman.
report__landing__purchase__desc: Monthly supplier spending with its breakdown.
report__landing__money__desc: Money received per payment method, with per-document detail.
report__landing__output__desc: Goods leaving the warehouse per period.
report__landing__inadequate__desc: Products whose stock hit the minimum threshold and need restocking.
report__landing__problematic__desc: Products with odd records that need review.
report-sales__lede: A month's sales: daily chart, this month's best, and sales by brand.
report__rank__empty: No data for this month yet.
report-purchase__lede: A month's spending: daily chart and the best supplier, brand, and type.
